tasks.label: 1 · Subir o banco (Docker)
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db && docker compose ps

osx.command: open -a Docker >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose up -d db && docker compose ps

linux.command: docker compose up -d db && docker compose ps

windows.command: docker compose up -d db; docker compose ps

tasks.label: 3 · Abrir o banco no navegador (Adminer :8080)
tasks.command: docker start modular-adminer || docker run -d --name modular-adminer --network modular-perfumes_default -e ADMINER_DEFAULT_SERVER=db -e ADMINER_DESIGN=dracula -p 8080:8080 adminer

osx.command: (docker start modular-adminer || docker run -d --name modular-adminer --network modular-perfumes_default -e ADMINER_DEFAULT_SERVER=db -e ADMINER_DESIGN=dracula -p 8080:8080 adminer) && sleep 2 && open http://127.0.0.1:8080

linux.command: (docker start modular-adminer || docker run -d --name modular-adminer --network modular-perfumes_default -e ADMINER_DEFAULT_SERVER=db -e ADMINER_DESIGN=dracula -p 8080:8080 adminer) && sleep 2 && xdg-open http://127.0.0.1:8080

windows.command: docker start modular-adminer; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { docker run -d --name modular-adminer --network modular-perfumes_default -e ADMINER_DEFAULT_SERVER=db -e ADMINER_DESIGN=dracula -p 8080:8080 adminer }; Start-Sleep 2; Start-Process http://127.0.0.1:8080
